analysis_type: Post-hoc deterministic reanalysis of saved EXP-004 methods and measurements; no refitting or new shots
distance_definition: sqrt(||q*w + A*s - t||^2 + ||s||^2); augmented lattice distance, not the residual-only norm in Lv et al.
limitations: Previously inspected development examples, not a final holdout; no new method selected or fitted here.
Babai retention guarantees no worsening of this objective; that alone is not evidence of quantum benefit.
Only 11/64 examples have a suboptimal Babai answer. All 64 are retained in the aggregate and the 11-case conditional view is explicitly identified.
An improvement in augmented lattice distance does not imply planted-secret recovery or improvement in the residual-only norm.
Exact ideal expectations are separated from one saved finite-shot batch. No physical hardware or noise is involved.
Classical local refinement has different per-candidate cost and domain from quantum sampling; no end-to-end speedup claim is made.
